app.title: Kid-Proof
footer.disclaimer: Kid-Proof helps you spot and reduce common risks. It is not a guarantee of safety and not medical advice.

welcome.title: Welcome to Kid-Proof
welcome.lead: A calm, step-by-step plan to reduce everyday hazards at home for your little one. Free, private, and it stays on this phone.
welcome.demoHint: One tap loads a ready-made plan for a 9-month-old and a 20-month-old.
welcome.or: Or start with your own family
welcome.step1Hint: A first name or nickname and a birth month. No exact birthdate.
welcome.step2Hint: Pick the rooms you want a checklist for.

about.title: About Kid-Proof
about.privacyText: Everything you enter stays on this device. There are no accounts and no tracking. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you choose to share a plan.
about.aiText: All advice comes from a reviewed knowledge base with linked sources, not from AI. AI helped build this app, and its use is logged in the project's AI_USE file.
about.limitsText: Kid-Proof cannot see your whole home, and it cannot promise a hazard is gone. Use it with your own judgment and your child's doctor. For poisoning, call Poison Help right away.
about.resetConfirm: Tap again to erase your family and plan
